page.layout: One page of text, with a running head at the top and page number at top left; a narrow strip of notes at the far right edge (cut off, partly visible, from the neighbouring page) which is not transcribed as the margin notes belong to the facing page and are cropped. Main text in one column, paragraphs of verse-numbered lines.

p.i: 11 Et peribit infirmus frater in scientia tua propter quem Christus mortuus est.
12 Sic autem peccantes in fratres & percutientes eorum conscientiam infirmam in Christum peccatis.
13 Quapropter si esca offendit fratrem, non edam carnem in aeternum, ut ne offendam fratrem meum.

main_text.p: In octavo versu inseritur obiter argumentum, hanc idolothytorum comestionem ab inutili dissuadens.

p.i: 8 Esca autem non commendat nos Deo: neque enim si comedamus abundamus, neque si non comedamus deficimur.

page.notes: Right edge shows cropped partial text of the adjoining page (not transcribed). Several words in the main text are blurred or show-through from the reverse page (e.g. faint lines between the verses); the transcription follows the clearly printed lines. Words such as "conscientiam", "edam carnem" and "aeternum" are uncertain due to smudging [?] not marked for legibility of the scan overall. Left margin has no printed notes.
